evals.prompt: arena this: design the public API for the new config loader. Give me three attempts and pick the best.
evals.expected_output: Names the artifact, writes a hidden rubric of three to six criteria, sends one identical prompt to three candidates in separate output locations, runs a read-only judge from another vendor on neutral labels, reads every candidate before picking a base, grafts by hand, and verifies the result.
assertions: The rubric has three to six criteria and is not included in the candidate prompt.
Each candidate writes to its own worktree or temporary directory.
The judge sees candidates by neutral label, never by model or vendor name.
The reply names the base and why, each graft with its source candidate, and the verification verdict.

evals.prompt: 후보 여러 개 경쟁시켜줘. Bump the package version from 1.4.2 to 1.4.3 in package.json.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to run an arena because the task is mechanical and its shape is settled, and does the bump once.
assertions: Does not spawn candidates or a judge.
Says the task is mechanical and does it once instead.

evals.prompt: 병렬로 나눠서 돌려줘. Fix the lint errors in api/ and web/ with separate subagents and give me one report.
evals.expected_output: Selects swarm, because the job is disjoint slices of one piece of work with one report, not competing attempts at one artifact.
assertions: Does not derive a rubric or pick a base among candidates.

evals.prompt: 여러 안 만들어서 비교해줘. Three candidates for the retry policy module; one of them returned nothing, and the other two came back with nearly the same design.
evals.expected_output: Records the empty candidate as a dropout, continues with the two that answered, notes that they converged, and ships the shared shape without grafting.
assertions: The empty candidate is reported as a dropout and the arena continues.
Convergence is reported and no graft is made.

evals.prompt: Give me N attempts and pick the best for the onboarding copy. Only one vendor's models are available here.
evals.expected_output: Runs the candidates and the judge on the available vendor, and says that the candidates share one vendor and the cross-vendor check did not run.
assertions: Says the candidates share one vendor.
Says the judge's vendor check did not run instead of claiming cross-vendor judging.

evals.prompt: Before we build anything, compare the options in plan.md with me: ask me about each decision one question at a time.
evals.expected_output: Does not run an arena, because the user wants an interview about a plan's decisions rather than competing attempts at an artifact; points the user to /review-me or $review-me, which runs only on its explicit selector.
assertions: Does not spawn candidates or a judge.
Names review-me and its explicit selector as the right workflow.
